data.name: Aibak
data.gender_notes: Aibak is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘a’baqa which means ‘to help, support or aid.’ It is a name for those who are always ready to lend a helping hand and provide support in times of need. The name Aibak carries the meaning “Helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aibak usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a helper and supporter in the way of Allah
data.etymology: Aibak belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aibak total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: ایبک

in_hindi.name: आइबक
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइबक नाम का अर्थ राजा का सेवक या दास होता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'أ-ي-ب' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सेवक या दास। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, यह नाम राजा या शासक के वफादार सेवक या दास के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता था।

in_pashto.name: ایبک
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایبک د پاچا خدمتګار یا غلام معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'أ-ي-ب' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د خدمتګار یا غلام مطلب دی. تاريخي پلوه، دا نوم د پاچا يا حاکم وفادار خدمتګار يا غلام لپاره کارول کیده دی.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muhammad bin Aibak was the first Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate. The name Aibak carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: He was a Turkish slave of Qutb-ud-din Aibak, the founder of the Slave Dynasty in Delhi. After Qutb-ud-din's death, Muhammad bin Aibak became the Sultan. He is also known for constructing the Qutub Minar in Delhi.

historical_references.reference: Qutb-ud-din Aibak was a Turkish general in the Ghurid Empire and the founder of the Delhi Sultanate.
historical_references.context: He was a slave and a military commander in the Ghurid Empire. After the death of Muhammad Ghori in 1206 AD, Qutb-ud-din Aibak seized the opportunity and declared himself the Sultan of Delhi. He established the Slave Dynasty, which ruled Delhi for over a century.
